# ReactionConfig

`jaff.core.reaction.config.ReactionConfig`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Settings of one reaction (`[network.reactions.reaction."<serialized>"]`).

`None` means unset: the value comes from the global settings.

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `duplicate_policy` | `str or None` | How two rate coefficients over the same temperature range are resolved: `"preserve-first"`, `"preserve-last"` or `"error"`. |
| `t_cutoff` | `str or None` | Rate behaviour outside the temperature range: `"clip"` or `"extrapolate"`. |
| `photo` | `PhotoConfig or None` | Photo-reaction settings. |
